comparison.objective: Release a camera plate from a cam clamp, clear a rear lip and place it upright on a pad; candidate rejects open cartons from a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-190 tests rotary-cam release, multi-retainer clearance and supported dismounting. Candidate tests synchronized moving grasp, flap avoidance and spill-free level transport.
comparison.success_condition: PR-190 requires cam release, mount clearance, upright pad placement, robot clearance and 1 s stability, with drop and fixture-displacement invalidations. Candidate requires retained loose contents, reject-tray placement, 3 s dwell and untouched closed-carton passage.
comparison.reason: Both include careful released placement, but the central mechanisms and failure modes differ materially.
